title: Laws About Leprous Diseases

questions.question: Who examined a person with a skin disease?
options: Aaron the priest or one of his sons
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron the priest or one of his sons
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:2 (ESV): "He shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests."

questions.question: What happened if the disease was confirmed as leprosy?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:3 (ESV): "And the priest shall look at him and pronounce him unclean."

questions.question: What must a person with leprosy shout?
Where must the leper live?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:46 (ESV): "He shall live alone. His dwelling shall be outside the camp."

questions.question: Could garments be infected with leprosy?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:47 (ESV): "When there is a case of leprous disease in a garment..."

questions.question: What color hair in a sore indicated unclean leprosy?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:3 (ESV): "And the hair in the diseased area has turned white... it is a case of leprous disease."

questions.question: If the sore had not spread after seven days of quarantine, what happened?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:5 (ESV): "Then the priest shall shut him up for another seven days."

questions.question: What if the leprosy covered the whole body and turned all white?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:13 (ESV): "If the leprous disease has covered all his body, he shall pronounce him clean... it has all turned white."

questions.question: What presence in the sore made it unclean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:14 (ESV): "But when raw flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean."

questions.question: What was done to a garment with persistent leprosy?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:52 (ESV): "He shall burn the garment... for it is a persistent leprous disease."

questions.question: What was a boil that healed but left a white swelling checked for?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:18-20 describes checking a healed boil for signs of leprosy.

questions.question: What appeared deeper than the skin in a leprous sore?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:3 (ESV): "And the disease appears to be deeper than the skin of his body."

questions.question: What happened to a clean person who had a rash that faded after washing?
options: He washed his clothes and was clean
questions.correctAnswer: He washed his clothes and was clean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:6 (ESV): "He shall wash his clothes and be clean."

questions.question: How did a man with a leprous disease on his head or beard appear?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:30 (ESV): "And if... there is in it thin yellow hair..."

questions.question: Leprosy in a garment was called what?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 13:51 (ESV): "It is a persistent leprous disease; it is unclean."

key_verse_text: He shall remain unclean as long as he has the disease. He is unclean. He shall live alone. His dwelling shall be outside the camp.
